Name: Pretty Office Chairs
Author: LadyZomkie
Description:
An updated version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6664]original chairs[/url], the only difference being this is for content patcher instead of custom furniture, since CF hasn't been updated since 2023.

This is the first thing I'd done (and uploaded) for Stardew Valley. I just really wanted a pretty office chair. I was originally just going to
recolor the in-game ones but then I realized they don't have wheels. I really wanted a chair with wheels.

Since these are recolors/edits of the in-game ones they rotate just like the original office chairs. [s]The 'prismatic' one has a different name, because I named it for my friend that helped me figure out what I was even doing and then said "how about a rainbow one"[/s]  [s]
[/s]The prismatic one is now named 'prismatic'.[s]
[/s]
You can find them in the catalog just like any other furniture. [s]Robin should also sell them.[/s] [s]Robin doesn't sell them as of now, but they [i]are[/i] in the catalog. Maybe I'll try and fix it later.[/s] These are a new item, so they don't replace the old chairs.

[b]Required mods:
Content patcher
SMAPI (obv)

Changelog:

1.1.0 - 10/05/25: Robin's finally selling my chairs, I had to threaten her. Now you can buy them without having to save up for the catalogue! Prismatic chair now costs 500g instead of 100g, cause it's fancier.
